Āsurīkalpa
--assigned to a Mahāpurāṇa. Alwar 2050.
--assigned to a. Atharvarahasya. BBRAS. 809 (Āsurīmahāprayoga; text same a. in RASB. VIII. i. 6071 (iv), called. Ā. kalpa). BORI. 291 of Viś. (i). 120 of 1880-81. 445 of 1884-86. 1105 of 1886-92. 1106 of 1886-92. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 81 (no. 285).
--assigned to Rudrayāmala. Dacca 138N.
--another text. RASB. VIII. i. 6070. 6072. 6156. (RASB. 6071 is a collection on the subject from different works (i) Āsurīvidhāna from Atharvavidyā. (ii) Āsurīkalpa from another anonymous work on Rājavaśīkaraṇa, comparable to a similar portion of RASB. VIII. i. 6070 an. having some relation to the Ā. kalpa of the Ath. pariśiṣṭa. (iii) another with a. alternate title of Bandaṇikākalpa. (iv) another text, 6072 is Laghvāsūrīkalpa, but text same a. 6071 (iv). In 6156 latter part agrees with ibid. 6070 an. 6071 (ii)).
